title: Plasma Dragon Tesla Coil
description: A glowing plasma ball styled as a neon dragon with green, yellow, pink and blue electrical arcs radiating from a central red spiral core. The dragon is contained within a transparent spherical glass chamber mounted on a metallic stand with visible '13' emblem, set against a dark background filled with swirling green and purple circular patterns.
